description: 'Advanced AWS deployment' against a resume that only lists AWS.

expectations.rationale: This scenario exists to confirm the advanced-demand rule from the other direction: 'Advanced AWS deployment' must not be treated as fully met by a skills-list mention, even though the same resume matches the EC2/S3 requirement outright in the scenario above. Whether the AWS requirement lands as PARTIAL is asserted in the unit tests, where it can be pinned precisely; here the assertion is the negative one.
